name: vibecheck-monorepo
description: Security scanner for AI-generated ("vibe-coded") apps — workspace root

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/cli
scripts.scan:fixture: npm run build && npm run fixtures:generate && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js scan --local ./fixtures/vulnerable-app
scripts.scan:fixture:history: npm run build && npm run fixtures:generate:history && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js scan --local ./fixtures/vulnerable-app-history
